steps.notes: Deterministic first-intake-pack schema defines required topic IDs for users/problem, runtime target/environment, stack/runtime, architecture preference, UI/design, security/compliance, NFR priorities, and scope/timeline.

Deterministic small-intake-pack schema defines required topic IDs for outcome/success criteria, impacted components, constraints/compatibility risk, required tests/acceptance checks, and done definition.
Intake persistence is fail-closed until required coverage is complete or bounded assumptions are explicitly confirmed.
Guided mode retains adaptive follow-ups with bounded rounds while enforcing deterministic minimum pack coverage.
Low-touch mode remains available but still enforces critical required coverage when mandatory fields are missing.
Evidence persistence contract includes asked_topics, missing_topics, and assumptions_confirmed for deterministic traceability.
Deterministic blocked reason codes are present for missing required answers and intake persistence block states.
Active/template parity is maintained for intake command, PO agent guidance, runbook, and README touchpoints.
Regression assertions cover first-intake flow, small-intake flow, low-touch compatibility, and blocked-on-missing-answer behavior.
Question-pack selection includes deterministic unknown-stack fallback to first-intake-pack.
